evals.prompt: Create a Datacore view that shows all my pages tagged #book in a table with columns for the page link, rating (from frontmatter), genre, and the date I finished reading it. Add paging with 25 items per page.
evals.expected_output: A complete datacorejsx codeblock with dc.useQuery for #book and @page, a COLUMNS array with 4 columns (link, rating, genre, date-finished), dc.Table component with paging={25}, and a View function return.

assertions.text: Defines COLUMNS array with id, value for link, rating, genre, and date-finished
Returns View function with dc.Table using rows={books} and columns={COLUMNS}
Sets paging={25} on the Table component
Uses row.value() for frontmatter field access (rating, genre, date-finished)

evals.prompt: Write a Datacore script that queries all tasks that are not completed, groups them by their parent page, and displays them as a hierarchical list where each parent page is a header and the tasks under it are shown as bullet points. Show only the first 3 levels of nesting.
evals.expected_output: A datacorejsx codeblock with dc.useQuery for @task and $completed = false, dc.useArray with groupBy to group by parent page, dc.List component with grouping headers and maxChildDepth={3}.

assertions.text: Uses dc.useQuery for @task with $completed = false filter
Uses dc.useArray with groupBy to group by parent page
Returns dc.List component with appropriate renderer
View function returns the list properly

evals.prompt: I have pages tagged #project. Write a Datacore view that shows a table of all project pages, with columns for the page link, a status field (or 'No Status' if missing), and the $ctime formatted nicely. Also show query timing info. Make it so only projects with a status field are shown.
evals.expected_output: A datacorejsx codeblock with dc.useQuery filtering by #project and @page, exists(status) filter, COLUMNS array with link, status (with fallback to 'No Status'), and formatted ctime, dc.Table with paging, and proper field access via row.value().

assertions.text: Filters to only pages with status using exists(status) in query
Defines COLUMNS with link, status (fallback to 'No Status'), and formatted ctime
Uses row.value() for field access with fallback for missing status
